edits.current: THE PRINCIPAL PAYROLL CASILLA ON THE WITHHOLDING SIDE. Sum of the income-tax withholding at source actually practised on work income paid to natural persons in the calendar month, across EVERY payroll run of the entity in that month (not only the regular run), in whole pesos, then rounded once to the nearest 1,000. Sources in the client's payroll: WT 2552 'Income Tax (employee)' (Deductions), plus WT 21330 'Personal Income Tax Withholding (Theoretical)' for the employees whose WT 2552 line is a zero-value Non Cash item and whose deduction is booked on WT 21330 (6 of 261 employees in the Sep-2026 run). Together they reconcile exactly to the Base of Withholding column V 'WITHOLDING TAX WITH CONTRIBUTION' (per employee, 2552 = V for 255 of 261 and 21330 = V for the other 6; run total 1,468,500,598). Do NOT use column X 'WITHOLDING TAX WITHOUT CONTRIBUTION'. The Base of Withholding covers one payroll run only: in Sep-2026 the Accumulated Report holds a further 144,635,503 of WT 2552 for 97 IDs outside that run, so the casilla is built from all runs of the month, not from one report. Do not use the report 'Payroll id' as the run key: the same run carries a different Payroll id in the Base of Withholding and in the G2N / Master Data reports. [DECISION PENDING - see Query to RA] (a) whether CONTINGENT WITHHOLDING (column Y, = X - V, present only for employees with AFC or voluntary-pension contributions and not deducted by any wage type) is excluded from this casilla; (b) whether withholding booked on WT 21129 (Terminations), 25832 (Stock awards vesting), 25833 (IC Local Country) and 25834 (Hypothetical - IC Foreign Country) enters here in the month it is practised; (c) whether withholding on the employees withheld at a flat 20% of gross income (client Tax Procedure 3; inferred from the rate to be the ET art. 408 non-resident withholding - no report labels them non-resident) is reported here or in casillas 111/112. Must reconcile to the sum of RetencionFuente (NIE177) across every electronic payroll document for the same month, after the nearest-1,000 rounding. It is one of the forty-two casillas summed into casilla 130.
edits.proposed: THE PRINCIPAL PAYROLL CASILLA ON THE WITHHOLDING SIDE. Sum of the income-tax withholding at source actually practised on work income paid to natural persons in the calendar month, across EVERY payroll run of the entity in that month (not only the regular run), in whole pesos, then rounded once to the nearest 1,000. Sources in the client's payroll: WT 2552 'Income Tax (employee)' (Deductions), plus WT 21330 'Personal Income Tax Withholding (Theoretical)' for the employees whose WT 2552 line is a zero-value Non Cash item and whose deduction is booked on WT 21330 (6 of 261 employees in the Sep-2026 run). Together they reconcile exactly to the Base of Withholding column V 'WITHOLDING TAX WITH CONTRIBUTION' (per employee, 2552 = V for 255 of 261 and 21330 = V for the other 6; run total 1,468,500,598). The same per-employee amount is reported as RetencionFuente (NIE177) in the client's electronic payroll documents of the same pay group (261 of 261 employees; total 1,468,500,598). Do NOT use column X 'WITHOLDING TAX WITHOUT CONTRIBUTION'. The Base of Withholding and the G2N cover one pay group and one payroll run only (G2N title 'Pay Group(s)' = CO - Monthly): in Sep-2026 the Accumulated Report holds a further 144,635,503 of WT 2552 for 97 IDs outside that pay group (93 of them paid WT 61100 'Weekly advance' and WT 62838 'Exceptional Advance'), so the casilla is built from every pay group and every payroll run of the month, not from one report. Do not use the report 'Payroll id' as the run key: the same run carries a different Payroll id in the Base of Withholding and in the G2N / Master Data reports. [DECISION PENDING - see Query to RA] (a) whether CONTINGENT WITHHOLDING (column Y, = X - V, present only for employees with AFC or voluntary-pension contributions and not deducted by any wage type) is excluded from this casilla; (b) whether withholding booked on WT 21129 (Terminations), 25832 (Stock awards vesting), 25833 (IC Local Country) and 25834 (Hypothetical - IC Foreign Country), and on the theoretical-tax WTs 21114 (Theoretical income Tax-5011) and 21619 (Theoretical Income Tax - Ajuste - 5035), enters here in the month it is practised - the client's electronic-payroll mapping already reports all of them as RetencionFuente (NIE177); (c) whether withholding on the employees withheld at a flat 20% of gross income (client Tax Procedure 3; inferred from the rate to be the ET art. 408 non-resident withholding - no report labels them non-resident) is reported here or in casillas 111/112. Must reconcile to the sum of RetencionFuente (NIE177) across every electronic payroll document for the same month, after the nearest-1,000 rounding. Caveat: the client's electronic-payroll mapping also reports the retiree / pensioner withholding WTs 21140 (Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees- 6799) and 21155 (Income Tax Pensioner) as RetencionFuente, so if that withholding is declared in casilla 94 the NIE177 reconciliation is against casillas 93 + 94, not casilla 93 alone (see Query to RA). It is one of the forty-two casillas summed into casilla 130.
